Class AbstractScenarioTensorAndEngineConfig

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.AbstractScenarioTensorAndEngineConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Scenario
public abstract class AbstractScenarioTensorAndEngineConfig extends Object implements Serializable
Base configuration state for Scenario encapsulating cultural and geological spatial tensor layers, spatial clipping boundaries, Type B cliodynamic engine parameters, scheduled planetary cataclysms, and deterministic execution toggles.

Designed as a transparent JavaBean superclass so Jackson JSON serialization and deserialization preserve a 100% flat, backward-compatible schema.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • isCoordinateWithinBounds

      public boolean isCoordinateWithinBounds(double lat, double lng)
      Checks if a geographical coordinate falls within the scenario's spatial boundaries. If spatial clipping is disabled, all coordinates are considered within bounds.
      Parameters:
      lat - latitude in degrees (-90 to +90)
      lng - longitude in degrees (-180 to +180)
      Returns:
      true if clipping is disabled or the coordinate is inside [minLat, maxLat] and [minLng, maxLng]

      public Map<String,Double> getCulturalAffinityMatrix()
      Gets the custom cliodynamic pairwise cultural affinity matrix overrides ($A_{i,j} \in [0.0, 100.0]$).

    • setCulturalAffinityMatrix

    • getPairwiseAffinity

      public double getPairwiseAffinity(String idA, String idB)
      Gets directional cultural affinity from origin polity idA towards target polity idB, defaulting to $50.0$ (neutral coexistence) if unspecified.

      Adheres to the directed square matrix architecture where $A(i \to j) \ne A(j \to i)$.

      Parameters:
      idA - source polity or cultural entity identifier (origin)
      idB - target polity or cultural entity identifier (target)
      Returns:
      affinity value in $[0.0, 100.0]$

    • adjustPairwiseAffinity

      public void adjustPairwiseAffinity(String idA, String idB, double delta)
      Adjusts the directed cultural affinity from origin polity idA towards target polity idB.

      In accordance with directed square matrix semantics, this modifies exclusively the directional link $A(idA \to idB)$ without symmetrically overwriting the reverse link $A(idB \to idA)$.

      Parameters:
      idA - source polity or cultural entity identifier
      idB - target polity or cultural entity identifier
      delta - affinity shift in percentage points (positive for reconciliation/trade, negative for grievance/war)
